**What problem does this solve**

Describe the situation this would help with. A concrete example (yours or a hypothetical adopting organization's) is more useful than an abstract description.

**Proposed change**

What you would want to see happen. If you already have an implementation idea, sketch it here; if not, that is fine too.

**Is this generally useful, or specific to one organization**

This project is a shared template, not any single organization's fork (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "What belongs in this repo" section). A feature tied to one organization's specific process, legal text, or internal workflow usually belongs in that organization's own downstream copy instead of here. If you are not sure which this is, say so and it can be discussed.

**Would you be able to work on this yourself**

- [ ] Yes, I would like to submit a PR for this
- [ ] I could, with some guidance
- [ ] No, just proposing the idea
